# PLAN — iteration 3
## Current state assessment
Iteration 2 is the verified incumbent at 3 LUTs and 4 FFs, with setup WNS 0.57 ns and hold WHS 0.057 ns. It meets timing, so this iteration must strictly reduce LUTs, or retain 3 LUTs and reduce FFs, while preserving the known `// @latency 0` annotation and the debouncer’s specified reset and eighth-sample behavior.

## Hypothesis
Using the counter’s modulo-8 overflow as the update event may let synthesis share terminal detection with the increment logic and reduce LUT count, though the small incumbent leaves limited room for improvement.

## Instruction for generator
In `debouncer_top`, replace the separate `stability_count == 3'd7` update-and-clear branch with a 4-bit temporary sum of the 3-bit count plus one; while `noisy != clean_reg`, load the sum’s low three bits back into the counter and update `clean_reg` only when the sum’s carry bit is set. Keep the equal-input count clear and synchronous active-high reset unchanged, retain the output register and `// @latency 0`, and preserve update on the eighth consecutive mismatching sample. Check the frozen testbench and all compile, simulation, routed metric-integrity, setup, hold, and strict LUT/FF objective gates.
